worlds.name: The Unlit
worlds.description: Not a Reach across the binding. Inside it. The only place a person stands with nothing above them.

zones.name: The Crossing
zones.description: Inside the binding. Nothing here is yours and nothing here is for sale.

zones.name: The Regard
zones.description: Where the binding is looking from. Act V.

itemTemplates.name: a hood worn thin
itemTemplates.description: It was somebody's, and the binding has had it long enough to take the colour out and nothing else.

itemTemplates.name: a coat still being held
itemTemplates.description: Whoever wore it did not let go of it. That is the only reason it is still a coat.

itemTemplates.name: a pair of keeping gloves
itemTemplates.description: Closed, and hard to open, and worth the trouble.

itemTemplates.name: a pair of standing greaves
itemTemplates.description: Made for holding a position. Everything down here that still exists was holding a position.

itemTemplates.name: a pair of walking boots
itemTemplates.description: Nothing in the binding is fast. The only thing that has ever got anyone out of here is walking.

itemTemplates.name: a shield turned outward
itemTemplates.description: It has been held facing the same way for so long that the other side is bright.

itemTemplates.name: a thing somebody kept
itemTemplates.description: Small, and worn, and carried by somebody all the way in here and not put down.

itemTemplates.name: a blade gone long in the dark
itemTemplates.description: The edge is wrong in a way that is entirely to your advantage.

itemTemplates.name: a binding spike
itemTemplates.description: Gate-stone, whole, never cut - the binding does not have seams. Somebody shaped this by wearing it away.

itemTemplates.name: a hammer for standing still with
itemTemplates.description: Heavy enough that you have to plant your feet, which down here is the point.

itemTemplates.name: something carried in
itemTemplates.description: It belonged to a person who walked in here on purpose. There have been more of those than anyone in the Reaches admits.

itemTemplates.name: a marker worn smooth
itemTemplates.description: One of the road stones, carried this far by something that had no reason to and did it anyway.

itemTemplates.name: an answer
itemTemplates.description: Not a thing. A position - the one the instrument at Thessivar has been holding for four hundred years, and it is here, and it is yours to give back.

itemTemplates.name: an answered oathmaul
itemTemplates.description: Head like a milestone, haft the length of a person. It was made to stop something. Finished. It has been all the way in and come back out, which almost nothing has.

itemTemplates.name: an answered hearthcenser
itemTemplates.description: A censer on a chain, weighted for swinging and never once used for incense. Finished. It has been all the way in and come back out, which almost nothing has.

itemTemplates.name: an answered stormrod
itemTemplates.description: Bronze wound with wire that stands the hair up on your arm when the weather turns. Finished. It has been all the way in and come back out, which almost nothing has.

itemTemplates.name: an answered quiet knife
itemTemplates.description: It does not catch the light. Somebody took a great deal of trouble over that. Finished. It has been all the way in and come back out, which almost nothing has.

mobTemplates.name: a drift
mobTemplates.description: A person shape that has been in the binding long enough to stop being one. It is not hostile. It is only still going.

mobTemplates.name: one of the long held
mobTemplates.description: It has been here since before Azhen measured anything, and it is still holding what it came in with.

mobTemplates.name: one of the recognised
mobTemplates.description: The Regard found this one. Whatever that means, it is what is left afterwards, and it is walking.

mobTemplates.name: the oldest thing still holding on
mobTemplates.description: It is not a god and it is not the binding. It is the first person who walked in here on purpose and did not stop.

mobTemplates.name: Vesh, who follows the gates
mobTemplates.description: A smith with a travelling anvil and no forge, who has been at every crossing anyone can remember and looks no older in any of the stories. She works for materials and will not take coin.

emotes.text: turns a piece over and puts it back in the bag unfinished
says, 'I do not sell. Bring me something and I will make it better.'
sets an anvil down that nobody saw her carrying

mobTemplates.name: someone who has been waiting
mobTemplates.description: A woman sitting on a marker stone with her pack beside her, entirely present, entirely calm, and not from any Reach you can place. She walked in on purpose.

emotes.text: checks the strap on a pack she is not going to put on
says, 'You can go back. I want you to know that before we talk.'
looks out at nothing in particular, without discomfort

rooms.title: The Arrival
rooms.description:
You come out of the ring onto a surface. Not ground - it does not end and it does not begin, and it takes a footprint and keeps it.

The ring behind you is a ring. From this side it is not set into anything.

You are the view now. Whatever a person on an Ossaran rim is squinting at, on a clear afternoon, leaning on a low wall with their heels knocking against it, is you.

rooms.title: The Turning Point
rooms.description:
A marker stone, one of Ossara's, standing upright a hundred paces from the gate with nothing holding it up.

Somebody carried it in and set it here so that whoever came next would have something to turn back at.

rooms.title: The First Stretch
rooms.description:
Walking. The surface gives very slightly and comes back. There is light and no source for it and no direction to it.

Recall does not answer here. You knew that. It is different knowing it.

rooms.title: The Scatter
rooms.description:
Things lying about over a wide area: a boot, a lamp, a coil of rope, a child's cup. None of them are damaged and none of them are together.

This is where people put things down.

rooms.title: The Quiet Mile
rooms.description:
The longest stretch, and the one people talk about afterwards. Nothing happens in it at all.

Sound does not carry and does not echo. Your own footfalls arrive normally, which is somehow worse.

rooms.title: The Second Marker
rooms.description:
Another of Ossara's stones, worn almost smooth, standing at the same interval as the first.

Whoever is doing this is ahead of you and has been for a very long time.

rooms.title: The Standing Crowd
rooms.description:
Forty or fifty of them, spread out, all facing the same way and all still going, at a walking pace, without arriving.

They do not turn to look at you. They have not stopped in a long time.

rooms.title: The Held Things
rooms.description:
A place where the long held have gathered without meaning to, each of them holding what they came in with, none of them within reach of another.

Sulveth keeps what is lost. This is where it is kept.

rooms.title: The Thinning Out
rooms.description:
Fewer of them here, and further apart, and the light has begun to have a direction after all.

It is coming from ahead.

You are the view now. Whatever a person on an Ossaran rim is squinting at, on a clear afternoon, leaning on a low wall with their heels knocking against it, is you.

rooms.title: The Near Approach
rooms.description:
Close enough now that the surface has a grain to it, running the way you are walking, like the grain in cut stone.

Everything in the binding is aligned on what is ahead. Everything. Including, now that you look down, your own footprints.

rooms.title: The Threshold
rooms.description:
The grain runs out and the surface becomes a face - flat, dark, and enormous, going up out of sight and down out of sight.

It is not a wall. There is nothing behind it. It is the outside of everything, seen from the inside.

You are the view now. Whatever a person on an Ossaran rim is squinting at, on a clear afternoon, leaning on a low wall with their heels knocking against it, is you.

rooms.title: What Was Carried In
rooms.description:
A drift of belongings against the face, deep, and sorted - by kind, by size, by something. Not by anybody.

Every Reach is represented. So are two that are not.

rooms.title: The Standing Ground
rooms.description:
A stretch of clear surface below the face where nothing is lying and nothing is walking, kept clear by use.

People have stood here. Many, over a long time, and in the same place.

rooms.title: The First Way In
rooms.description:
A ring, half the size of the gates and much rougher, lying flat and half sunk into the surface.

It is older than Azhen's work by a long way. Somebody made a door into the binding before anybody made a door between Reaches.

rooms.title: The Long Watch
rooms.description:
Where the ones who came in on purpose stopped. Their gear is here, laid out, in order, the way people lay out gear they expect to pick up again.

There are forty sets. There is one person.

rooms.title: The Worn Place
rooms.description:
A patch of the face rubbed to a shine at the height of a hand, over an area about the width of a person's reach.

Somebody has been touching the same spot for longer than the Reaches have had names.

rooms.title: The Facing Place
rooms.description:
Directly under the face, close enough to put a palm on it. It is neither warm nor cold. It is exactly the temperature of whatever touches it.

From here you can tell that it is not flat. It is very slightly curved, and the curve is towards you, and it is the size of everything.

It is recognition, not attention. It has never had to search. Whatever it has been watching for since before Azhen took the first reading, it can see from here, and so can you, and it is behind you.

rooms.title: The Answer
rooms.description:
The last of it. The face, the standing ground, and one place to stand where somebody has stood before.

There is nothing here to fight. There has never been anything here to fight. There is a question, and it has been waiting a very long time for somebody to be in a position to answer it.

rooms.title: What Is Owed
rooms.description:
A niche in the face, worn rather than cut, with a stone seat in it and a view of nothing whatsoever.

Kheddran binds people by their word. The Unlit binds the Reaches by being there. The question is whether the second is owed anything by the things it holds, and it is not rhetorical, and you are the one being asked.

quests.name: What People Carried
quests.description: Somebody has been setting Ossaran marker stones inside the binding, a hundred paces apart, for longer than the Reaches have had names. She is at the far end, and she would like to know how many came after her.

dialogue.giverOffer: 'You can go back,' she says first. 'Say it back to me.' Then, when you have: 'Good. Bring me eight things that people carried in. Not things they dropped - things they were still holding.'
dialogue.giverInProgress: 'Eight. The long held have them. They will not give them up, because that is the entire remaining content of them.'
dialogue.turninReady: She turns each one over. 'Forty sets of gear on the standing ground,' she says, 'and I have been counting arrivals for a very long time, and the number is much higher than forty.' She sets them down in a row. 'Most people go back. I want that written down somewhere.'

quests.name: Who Set The Stones
quests.summary: Bring five worn markers to the one who has been waiting.
quests.description: The marker stones go all the way in, at a hundred paces, worn smoother the further you get. Somebody has been carrying Ossara's road into the binding for a very long time.

dialogue.giverOffer: 'You noticed the stones,' she says. 'Everyone notices the stones and nobody asks. Bring me five worn ones. The worn ones are the old ones and the old ones are the ones I want.'
dialogue.giverInProgress: 'Five. The further in, the smoother. That is not weather. There is no weather.'
dialogue.turninReady: She lines them up by wear, oldest first, and does not touch the oldest. 'I set that one,' she says. 'I was going to walk out to the face and back and I wanted to be able to find the door.' She sits back. 'I never did walk back. I have been about to for rather a long time.'

quests.name: What Is Owed
quests.summary: Take the answer from the oldest thing still holding on, and give it back.
quests.description: The instrument at Thessivar has held one position for four hundred years without ever needing to search. From the facing place you can see what it is looking at, and it is behind you.

dialogue.giverOffer: 'Here is what nobody has told you,' she says, 'because nobody has been in a position to. The Regard is not looking at the Reaches. It is looking *for* something, it has never once lost it, and if you stand at the facing place you will work out what it is in about four seconds.' She stands up. 'There is one thing still holding on down there that was here before I was. It has the answer. It has been keeping it because nobody came.'
dialogue.giverInProgress: 'Under the face. It is not a god and it is not a boss and it will not negotiate, because there is nothing left in it that could. Take the answer off it and bring it to the niche.'
dialogue.turninReady:
She takes it, and does not look at it, and puts it into the niche in the face, and sits down on the stone seat.

'Kheddran binds people by their word,' she says. 'The Unlit binds the Reaches by being there. Nobody ever asked it to and nobody has ever thanked it and it has never once let go.' She looks up at you. 'It has been watching for somebody to notice. That is the whole of it. That is what recognition means.'

'You can go back now. Most people do. I would like you to.'

quests.name: The Oathmaul, answered
quests.description: Vesh works for materials and not for coin, and she has decided what she is making for you before you asked.

dialogue.giverOffer: Vesh holds a hand out without looking up. 'Give it here. It has been through something and I can do more with it now than I could before.'
dialogue.giverInProgress: 'The one I gave you. I am not making a second - I am making that one again, and better.'
dialogue.giverComplete: 'When it has been through something. Not before.'
dialogue.turninReady: She takes a long time over it. When she gives it back she keeps hold of it a moment longer than she needs to. 'That is as far as it goes,' she says. 'There is nothing past here to make it out of.'
